assets.Asset Description: Agentic AI solution that accelerates conceptual telecom network design for telecom sales cycles by recommending topology, generating and reviewing diagrams, and explaining design rationale to users.
assets.Owner/Contact: Ed Bobrin; Roma Irungbam; Ravi K Misra
assets.Primary Use Case: Accelerate pre-sales network design for telecom opportunities, reduce manual effort, and improve design quality and speed to revenue.
assets.Dependencies/Required Stack: LangGraph, Azure OpenAI, FastAPI, React, Azure AI Search, Cosmos DB, Azure Blob Storage, Azure Key Vault, Application Insights, Log Analytics, Managed Identity
assets.Evidence of Value: Targets the 30-40% of telecom sales cycle time spent on network design; addresses manual process issues including slow turnaround, lack of standardization, scalability constraints, and human design errors.

assets.Asset Description: Composable customer intelligence solution that unifies customer data into a 360-degree profile and activates insights across channels and enterprise decision-making functions.
assets.Owner/Contact: John Dubois; Vineet M Sahni; Abhinav Dewan; Ryan Webster; Tiffany Huang; Kelly Rao
assets.Primary Use Case: Enable unified customer intelligence, segmentation, activation, and enterprise decisioning for growth, margin expansion, and operational efficiency.
assets.Dependencies/Required Stack: Cloud data platform or warehouse, identity resolution, customer 360 model, CDP integration and storage layers, activation channels, analytics and AI or ML capabilities
assets.Evidence of Value: Source cites 10-30% uplift in CLV and loyalty, 30-50% campaign ROI, 2-3x faster cross-functional decision making, and $5-20m data-driven incremental revenue potential.

assets.Asset Name: Composable CDP Proof-of-Concept and Implementation at Kimberly-Clark
assets.Asset Description: Client project to evaluate composable CDP vendors, define use cases and synthetic data models, establish evaluation criteria, and support implementation on Snowflake with a Customer 360 model.
assets.Primary Use Case: Replace a packaged CDP with a future-ready composable CDP while leveraging Snowflake and reducing data silos, inflexibility, and vendor lock-in.
assets.Dependencies/Required Stack: Snowflake, Customer 360 data model, medallion architecture, vendor evaluation framework, synthetic data model, program oversight and implementation support
assets.Evidence of Value: Enabled Kimberly-Clark to select Hightouch as the future CDP, define an implementation roadmap, and accelerate toward a Q3 2026 go-live.

assets.Asset Description: Client project establishing a privacy-first customer intelligence capability by linking first-party transaction data with third-party attributes through a secure cleanroom and scalable composable architecture.
assets.Primary Use Case: Create enterprise-wide customer intelligence and decision support where customer visibility was limited by fragmented data, no PII, and no loyalty program.
assets.Dependencies/Required Stack: Secure data cleanroom, third-party data vendor integration, core warehousing platform, managed services, cloud modernization, composable integration
assets.Evidence of Value: Delivered a scalable foundation for actionable customer insights, supported loyalty strategy and cross-functional decisioning, and enabled ongoing managed-services-based activation.
